title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
abstract_first: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).
